cases.name: welcome-full-fields
cases.note: Compression, QoS, UDP acceleration fields and a message in the welcome (client has UDP off, so only parsing).

note: SoftEtherClient.connect against FakeSoftEtherServer. events are ordered across connections (conn = stream index). c2s http bodies are hex, except the watermark upload (watermark: true + the random padding behind the constant image). Replay: feed `entropy` draws in order, check the client's bytes equal the c2s events, answer with the s2c events.
